recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: patches racing ahead of public disclosure
games metered by the hour like parking
kernel secrets surfacing before their time
autumn storm flooding the Mediterranean coast
heavy drizzle settling over San Francisco at dusk

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Steer a paper boat through autumn gutters, scooping fallen leaves before they clog the drain — each leaf is a half-written thought you ferry to shore.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: swipe left/right to change gutter lanes
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: clearing a drain triggers a satisfying whoosh and the boat glides faster for three seconds
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: leaves pile thicker, gutters narrow, drizzle becomes a steady pour

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Flip face-down tiles to seal kernel patches before they leak — match vulnerability pairs, but one wrong flip exposes the whole board.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: each matched pair pulses green and the board shrinks by one row
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: grid expands, unmatched tiles auto-reveal after shorter intervals
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: terminal phosphor green on curved CRT glass

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw wire paths between parallel agent nodes on your phone screen — tasks cascade when routes connect, but crossed wires short-circuit the whole chain.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag finger to draw a wire between two nodes
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: a clean chain reaction lights up every node in sequence with a single satisfying pulse
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: more nodes spawn mid-round, existing wires become obstacles you must route around
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: neon wireframe flow diagrams on matte black

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Tap in rhythm to keep a streaming hourglass from emptying — each on-beat tap adds sand, but drift costs you minutes you never get back.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: perfect streaks make the hourglass glow and buy you five bonus seconds
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: tempo climbs, off-beat taps drain sand twice as fast
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: holographic mini arcade cabinet floating in fog
